narrative: As a 37-year-old skilled professional with a stable employment history of four to seven years, you have several strengths in your profile, yet your recent business loan application for 7,685 DM was denied. Such an extended repayment period increases the long-term uncertainty of the loan, making it the most influential reason for the denial. To improve your standing for future applications, you might consider requesting a smaller loan amount over a much shorter timeframe, perhaps closer to the two-year mark. Additionally, focusing on maintaining a positive balance in your checking account for several months would demonstrate the financial stability needed to manage new debt. Building up your savings beyond the current level of less than 100 DM would also provide the necessary collateral to balance out the risks associated with a large business investment.
